links.rationale: C024 loses simultaneous compatibility; C025 restores it only at canonical generator-signature level. The child must separate correlation repair from genuinely noncanonical closure information.
Any closure-derived score can still fail if one derived fact or pair resource is reused across many obligations; representation size alone is not accumulation.
Even a representation that exposes new closure structure can be irrelevant on a target whose adjacency predicate already compiles to a cheap unrestricted construction.
Both show that a compressed surrogate can be mathematically valid while deleting a root-critical coordinate; the child therefore audits representation faithfulness before scoring.

The normalized G_NEQ partition-closure collapse is only a source-bound specialization of the C025 first-order canonical-collapse warning. It does not strengthen the warning outside the exact normalized interface and does not imply a P-vs-NP or source-general closure result.
